newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close mostly higher.

text.p: Rubber futures closed most higher across the board in moderate trade on some late buying interest in line with firmer Japanese prices, brokers said on Monday.
Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were firmer on constant short-covering after drifting with narrow ranges.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning, but prices were marked up slightly in the afternoon as some speculative buying interest emerged in sympathy with higher prices in Tokyo and Kobe," a local broker said.

"Prices were a little bit firmer in the afternoon but activity was limited by a lack of Chinese inquiries and continued lack of movement in the ring sessions. Volume was moderate," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, March RSS3 rose 1.50 cents to 121.50 U.S. cents a kg.
April RSS1 rose 1.25 cents to 170.75 Singapore cents (US$1.22) a kg.
March TSR20 was unchanged from last Friday's settlement of 164.75 Singapore cent (US$1.18) a kg.
